description: Every first-order theory true in the ordinary natural-number order has a nonempty model carrying an infinite descending sequence for its interpreted relation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.descending_model
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.language.Theory) (hT : ℕ ⊨ T) :
  ∃ M a, ∀ (i : ℕ), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.edge (a (i + 1)) (a i)
